Definition: from G5259 and G4154; to breathe gently, i.e. breeze:--blow softly.
BiblicalUsage: The word hypopnéō carries the sense of to blow softly, to breeze. In Acts 27:13, the text says "And when the south wind blew softly."
TheologicalSignificance: I take hypopnéō as it stands: to blow softly, to breeze.
RelatedTopics: Nature and Creation; God's Providence; Peace
